replace: // a practice result falls through to the shared restart branch
why: Puts a practice result back through the shared restart branch, which is where issue #323 found it lying in two directions at once: on a loss it fell to `landOnCampaignBoard` and built `deps.levels.start` -- the RUN's current level, as a campaign session -- so a button labelled Retry moved the player to a different level in a different kind of session; on a win with a level after it, the `next !== null` arm advanced practice through the campaign sequence instead. Both survive every assertion about the run, because neither writes it.
killedBy: startGameWith: canonical session identity at the production boundary Practice a practice RETRY rebuilds the level it was on, still as practice
